channel.title: Pier & Point · P10
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for P10 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · P10: OCII's September 2023 presentation lists P10 among the parcels Recreation and…
item.description: OCII's September 2023 presentation lists P10 among the parcels Recreation and Parks "will manage", with transfer planned by the end of December 2023; it is a plan and does not say P10 was complete. The Board of Supervisors adopted Resolution 574-23 on December 5, 2023 authorizing termination of the ground lease. OCII's December 2019 Land Use Map labels the island in Mission Bay Circle "P10". Sources differ on how finished the Circle was in November 2011, and none dates the park itself. Source: https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf ; https://sfbos.org/sites/default/files/r0574-23.pdf ; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf.

item.title: Correction · P10: The record's 2010 under-construction milestone had no year in its source (EPA's…
item.description: The record's 2010 under-construction milestone had no year in its source (EPA's July 2012 fact sheet), so it became a fact about the $760,000 subgrant. The November 2011 milestone had read the press tour as showing the circle not yet functional; EPA's advisory for that tour celebrates the completion of Mission Bay Drive and Circle, so the status was removed. The September 2023 open-space deck says RPD 'will manage' P10 rather than already managing it. A citation to our own mapping notes was replaced by the Dec 2019 land use map, the Bay Crossings article is dated December 2011, the map shape now cites its sources, and the aerial photo caption no longer says 'from a departing flight'. Source: US EPA Region 9, Brownfields RLF Success Stories: California DTSC Subgrants, 2012-07 (https://archive.epa.gov/region9/brownfields/archive/web/pdf/r9-rlf-fs-subgrants.pdf); US EPA press advisory, 2011-11-04 (https://www.epa.gov/archive/epapages/newsroom_archive/newsreleases/f331b33bcc8cb8cf8525793e00531a9a.html); OCII, Mission Bay Parks Open Space (CAC Item 2), 2023-09 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf); OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf); Bay Crossings, 2011-12 (https://www.baycrossings.com/earth-friendly-redevelopment-in-mission-bay/).

item.title: Milestone · P10: OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation to the… (~Sep 2023)
item.description: OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation to the Mission Bay CAC (September 2023) lists P10 among the parcels RPD 'will manage', with the open space to transfer "by the end of December 2023" (an expected date), and not among the parcels listed 'when built'. This is a plan; it does not say P10 was complete or when it was built. The Board of Supervisors adopted Resolution 574-23 on December 5, 2023, authorizing the termination of OCII's ground lease to the Mission Bay Parks (a legal authorization; no source read confirms the transfer itself took place) (~Sep 2023). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (sfocii.org), 2023-09; San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2023-12-05.
item.source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (sfocii.org), 2023-09; San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2023-12-05

item.title: Milestone · P10: EPA's November 4, 2011 media advisory announces a tour of Mission Bay… (~Nov 2011)
item.description: EPA's November 4, 2011 media advisory announces a tour of Mission Bay 'to celebrate the completion of Mission Bay Drive and Circle'; Bay Crossings (Dec 2011) reports guests got 'a first peek at Mission Bay Circle, a landscaped turnaround that will eventually serve as a gateway to the park corridor'. Neither source separately dates the P10 island itself (~Nov 2011). Source: US Environmental Protection Agency (archived press release), 2011-11-04; Bay Crossings, 2011-12.
